Six photo-led sample posts

Unofficial samples created using open-license produce photography (CC0/CC-BY via Wikimedia Commons) and advice from the Kings Seeds Sowing and Growing blog.

01

Seasonal sowing

Idea: your home page line, "There's still time to get growing for summer", paired with fresh harvest photography.

Caption: Still time to sow! Sweet corn, beans, zucchini, cucumber and basil all love the warm soil of late November. Pick one, sow it this week, and tell us what went in. #KingsSeeds #sowing #NZgardening

Mon 30 Nov, 6:30pm. FB and IG, 4:5

02

Seed-packet hero

Idea: make the packet the hero over real sweet corn photography, using a clean studio mock-up.

Caption: Sweet corn is in the shop. Sow from spring to early summer in a warm, sunny spot and give it room to grow tall. Link in bio. #KingsSeeds #sweetcorn

Fri 4 Dec, 5:30pm. FB and IG, 4:5

03

How-to-sow carousel

Idea: turn your carrot blog guide into a photo-led five-slide swipeable how-to (all 5 slides on page 3).

Caption: How to sow carrots in five steps: loosen the soil, sow thin, keep the top lightly moist, wait 10 to 14 weeks, brush back and check. Save this for your next sowing. #KingsSeeds #carrots

Wed 2 Dec, 12:15pm. IG carousel and FB, 4:5

04

Reel storyboard

Idea: show how fast zucchini grows with real vine-to-plate cuts so viewers pick small and often (6 frames on page 3).

Caption: Blink and your zucchini is a marrow. Pick small, pick often, eat today. #KingsSeeds #zucchini

Thu 3 Dec, 6:30pm. IG and FB Reel, 9:16

05

Garden to plate

Idea: finish the growing story at the dinner table with real zucchini ribbon food photography.

Caption: From the garden to the plate in five minutes. Shaved zucchini ribbons, a squeeze of lemon, olive oil and torn basil. What is on your plate this weekend? #KingsSeeds #gardentoplate

Sat 5 Dec, 8:30am. FB and IG, 4:5

06

Growing is for everyone

Idea: bring your line "growing is for everyone" to life with a sunlit windowsill basil pot.

Caption: Growing is for everyone, even with no garden. A pot of sweet basil on a sunny sill is a great start. Which herb will you try first? #KingsSeeds #potgardening

Sun 6 Dec, 9:00am. FB and IG, 4:5
